notes: part = steamui-watch key(s); profiles address parts, never hashes.
selector = the hashes this build's DOM uses. steamui-watch and CSS Loader list several per key; unused ones are dropped.
Do not export readable names: CSS Loader's css_translations.json maps EventInfo and Title to dead hashes and lacks EventTime.
props = Steam's computed value before any edit.
links: a prop with a link follows another part's prop (alpha scales it) until it has its own edit. Steam's 139/220 grey ratio gives EventTime 0.63.

parts.label: Header And Bottom Bar
parts.notes: Merged with the Bottom bar (3AYJPRJR_BasicFooter, user 2026-11-21). The header band is a ::before, so its pseudo is in the selector. Focus is the header only: Steam has no focus colour for the bottom bar. On store pages Steam makes the header (HeaderOpaque) and bar (Opaque) solid black; `underlay` paints the Home screen colour there, under the band / under the bar colour, so they look as on home (user 2026-11-21).
